nome_articolo: Infinite The Crow Eric Draven Luxury Eternal Edition 1/4 Plus Format (Statua)
descrizione:
Infinite Statue & Collectibles presents The Crow – Eric Draven Luxury Eternal Edition 1/4 Plus Format Statue, a premium offering for the premium collector's market.
This unique and ultra-exclusive version stands out for its use of the highest quality materials: genuine leather clothing (pants and overcoat), real hair, a metal candelabra, and a katana blade, for an extremely realistic and distinctive impact.
The statue includes two interchangeable bases: a standard one with the logo and a scenic one with flickering LED flames, enhancing its display appeal at the point of sale.
With its impressive size, strong stage presence, and a rich array of iconic accessories, it represents a high-end product, ideal for expert collectors and specialized retailers.
Limited edition of 333 numbered pieces worldwide.
A distinctive piece, designed to position itself in the most exclusive segment of the market.
